text: Clipwise was founded by Rene Turcios in San Francisco in 2026. It is an MCP-first AI video clipping app: AI agents submit long videos through an MCP server, and the hosted editing pipeline returns short viral clips.

Clipwise pricing: a free tier includes 60 minutes of clipping per month with a small watermark. Paid credit packs remove the watermark and add priority processing. There is no paid advertising budget; growth is zero-cost organic outreach to podcast and radio creators.
The go-to-market strategy is zero-cost and creator-led: personalized outreach to podcasters and radio hosts, a public launch thread, and build-in-public posting. No funding round has been announced.
